description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You would gain a condition with a duration from a failed save.

Delay an incoming condition's onset by one round.

The condition's onset is delayed until the start of your next turn instead of applying immediately. It still applies in full once it arrives — The Someday only postpones, it never forgives.

cinderfall.incomplete: Delays a durationed condition's onset by one round after a failed save. No rule-element shape defers an already-triggered condition grant to a later turn; no matching precedent found in pf2e-source within this pass's research budget. Flagged as absence-of-evidence, same caveat as everything-in-its-time.
